subject: Biology
question: Comprehensive examination of The Cell: theoretical foundations, analytical derivations, and problem-solving application.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain in detail the fundamental laws, definitions, and mathematical formulation of Cell Theory.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Apply the core concepts of Microscopy (Light vs Electron microscope) to solve standard textbook numerical/analytical problems.

modelAnswer:
(a) Detailed theoretical discussion of Cell Theory with necessary mathematical expressions and graphical/diagrammatic representation.

3 marks for complete mathematical formulation or diagram
